user_sentences: what is the basic unit of life
answers: A cell is the basic structural and functional unit of life. Some organisms consist of one cell, while others are made of many cells.
DNA stands for deoxyribonucleic acid. It is a molecule that stores genetic information.
RNA stands for ribonucleic acid. RNA molecules perform many roles in cells, including helping use genetic information.

user_sentences: what does the cell membrane do
answers: The cell membrane, also called the plasma membrane, forms the boundary of a cell and helps regulate what enters and leaves the cell.

user_sentences: what is the powerhouse of the cell
answers: Mitochondria are organelles found in eukaryotic cells and are involved in cellular energy conversion.
Ribosomes are cellular structures that help make proteins.
